steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In January 2026, a guest on Equity Mates highlighted EVT's portfolio of Event Cinemas, Thredbo and the QT Hotels brand, plus hotels in New Zealand, as a way to play domestic tourism, noting Australia felt cheap to visitors and upcoming sporting events could drive demand.

In February 2025, Equity Mates explained EVT ran Event Cinemas and owned Thredbo and other ski resorts, and offered a shareholder benefits card with discounts on movies, hotel rooms and food and beverages.

episode.title: Bad news for banks & miners, where did all the dividends go & stocks with freebies

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?
Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In January 2026, a guest on Equity Mates said EVT owned some hotel properties but was shifting to a more asset light model, keeping management rights while property investors sought around 8 to 9 per cent returns on the hard assets.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In February 2025, Equity Mates noted EVT traded at about $12 a share and that accessing its shareholder benefits card required 500 shares, roughly $6,000 at that price.
